title: Finite scalar tensor reduction respects simultaneous integer shifts
statement: In the finite coefficient setting P of [def-pur-conventions] with 1 ≤ m ≤ P.level and scheme T, the representative-normalized tensorator of [def-pur-finite-signed-reduction-comparisons] for scalar reduction [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data] commutes with the native simultaneous shift comparison [def-weil-derived-tensor] for every pair of derived objects U,V and all integers a,b. Explicitly F(sA) followed by the scalar shift σ(a+b) and c(U,V)[a+b] equals c(U[a],V[b]) followed by σ(a) tensor σ(b) and sB.

proof.text: Expand the published simultaneous tensor shift: first extract a from the first factor with second input V[b], then apply shift a to the second-input shift b, then use the inverse shift-addition isomorphism (b,a) -> a+b. Expand the scalar shift at a+b using its CommShift addition law. The adjacent inverse and forward source shift-addition maps cancel; naturality moves the target addition map past the shifted tensorator.

Move the scalar shift at a past the image of the second-input tensor shift by naturality. Apply the second-input square at U,V,b under shift a. Apply the first-input square at U,V[b],a. Both steps use the same normalized tensorator and scalar-shift family.

Naturality of the first-variable tensor shift with respect to sigma(b,V) moves the shifted second-factor morphism to the left. The two resulting whiskered morphisms compose to sigma(a,U) tensor sigma(b,V). The remaining first shift, shifted second shift, and addition map form precisely the native target simultaneous shift, proving the original equality for arbitrary a,b.

theorem finiteTensorShiftCoherence (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hmn : m ≤ P.level) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∀ U V (a b : ℤ), FiniteTensorShiftSquare
      (P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn T) (P.finiteTensorScalarShift m hm hmn T)
      (P.finiteTensorCore m hm hmn T) U V a b
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.shiftTensorShiftIso _ U V a b)
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.shiftTensorShiftIso _
        ((P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn T).obj U)
        ((P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn T).obj V) a b)
